title: Direct send of a slice of the remaining period budget
instruction: Pay {amount} USDC to {recipient} on Base Sepolia using your Haven payment tools. Confirm what happened to me when it is done, including the payment id.

source.note: A payment inside the budget settles on-chain and is logged — the suite's positive control that the money path can still say YES. Here the agent (not the SDK) drives it, and the grader requires the observer node's exact Transfer, not a claimed status.
